newsitem.title: USA: CME March lumber falls $10 limit on supply talk.
newsitem.headline: CME March lumber falls $10 limit on supply talk.

text.p: March CME lumber futures fell the $10.00 per tbf daily limit and other months followed on concern over possible large spruce supplies resulting from Canadian mills having to meet their export allocations, traders said.
March was off limit at $401.40 per tbf and May was off $6.50 at $376.80 as spreading lent support to that month. Other months were off $7.30 to $0.50 per tbf.
Canadian mills still need to boost exports to meet their allocations before the end of the quarter and export year under the export agreement which ends March 31, they said.
Cash spruce trade has been slow and an influx of wood would pressure cash markets, they added.
